newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa follows New York higher in PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa follows New York higher in PM.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended higher after a New York-inspired jump in afternoon trade, traders said.
But the strength of sterling against the US dollar meant that the rise in London was held back, they said.
September, the most active contract last traded 20 stg higher at 1,131 stg, having reached a high of 1,135 stg. September volume was 4,300 of a total 11,024 lots.
Conversely, sterling's strength has helped New York to rise.

"New York is now steaming higher. London is following suit," one trader said. The main impetus behind the rise came from relief that Friday's Commitments of Traders report was not as bearish as some had feared, he said. There was no new fundamental news.
"Fundamentally it's all rather confused," the trader said.
